title: Normalized singleton scalar comparison on cochain representatives
statement: For an essentially small site C, inverse ring-sheaf sequences B,D, natural ring map a : B → D, normalized scalar models S with coherence T, and sequence scalar model A, use the fixed ordinary and derived singleton/scalar comparisons [def-pur-system-singleton-scalar-comparisons]. For every n and every unbounded B_n-complex P, d_n(Q(P)) followed by the target composite universal comparison equals the source composite universal comparison followed by localization of the ordinary singleton scalar comparison. No K-flatness hypothesis is required for this equality (it is required only for invertibility of its universal comparisons).

source.place: Parent Steps 7--8: Stacks 0FND, 09T5 and 0D6D, with Zheng Construction 4.1.

proof.text: Transport the normalized singleton transpose across the exact sequence equivalence and its canonical derived compositor, retaining the ordinary adjunction. Compose this normalized transpose with scalar transpose on each side of the evaluation/restriction square. The normalizedAdjunction_composition identity gives the transpose formulas for both composite universal comparisons.

In each degree the ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness map transposes to the target composite unit. The right square is the identity on sections; its exact localization satisfies the corresponding equation with the inverse factorization comparisons. Apply normalizedAdjunction_uniqueness to these two normalized transpose formulas and this right comparison equation. Identify the ordinary uniqueness map on complexes degreewise with NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex. The resulting equality is exactly the asserted equation for all P.

theorem singletonScalarDerivedIso_rep (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (systemLevel B n) ℤ) :
      (singletonScalarDerivedIso S T a A n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          singletonScalarTargetComparison S T a n P =
        singletonScalarSourceComparison S T a A n P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (singletonScalarOrdinaryIso S T a A n)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
